# Leverline

> Leverline helps small and mid-sized businesses find, build and run the AI use cases that grow revenue and cut costs — from private LLMs and AI receptionists to lead engines and Databricks/Snowflake machine learning.

## Use cases
- [Private & Local LLMs](https://jacobroutzong.dev/apps/leverline/use-cases/private-local-llm/): We design, deploy and maintain private large language models that run on a server in your office, in your own cloud account, or fully air-gapped. Your team gets modern AI without sending client data to a third party.
- [AI Knowledge Assistant](https://jacobroutzong.dev/apps/leverline/use-cases/ai-knowledge-assistant/): A secure assistant that searches your SOPs, policies, contracts, tickets and shared drives and answers in plain language, with citations back to the source so people can trust it.
- [AI Workflow Automation](https://jacobroutzong.dev/apps/leverline/use-cases/ai-workflow-automation/): We find the repetitive, rules-plus-judgment work clogging your team's week and turn it into reliable automated workflows, with AI handling the reading, writing and deciding, and people approving what matters.
- [AI Document Processing](https://jacobroutzong.dev/apps/leverline/use-cases/ai-document-processing/): We automate the reading of invoices, purchase orders, bills of lading, contracts, claims and intake forms: extracting the fields you need, checking them against your records and pushing them into your systems.
- [AI Lead Generation & Scoring](https://jacobroutzong.dev/apps/leverline/use-cases/ai-lead-generation/): We build a lead engine that enriches every inbound lead, scores it against the customers you actually win, responds in minutes and gives your reps a prioritized list every morning.
- [AI Ad Targeting & Optimization](https://jacobroutzong.dev/apps/leverline/use-cases/ai-ad-targeting/): Ad platforms optimize toward whatever signal you send them. We connect your first-party sales data so Google, Meta and LinkedIn bid for customers who buy and stay, rather than people who only fill out forms.
- [AI Social Media & Content Engine](https://jacobroutzong.dev/apps/leverline/use-cases/ai-social-media-content/): We build a content system trained on your brand voice that turns interviews, webinars and expertise into posts, short-form video, newsletters and SEO articles, with a human editor approving everything.
- [AI Personalization & Recommendations](https://jacobroutzong.dev/apps/leverline/use-cases/ai-personalization/): We build recommendation and personalization systems that use your order and browsing data to tailor product suggestions, offers and email content to each customer.
- [AI Customer Support Agents](https://jacobroutzong.dev/apps/leverline/use-cases/ai-customer-support/): We deploy AI support agents that answer common questions from your actual policies and order data, triage everything else, and hand off to people with the full context.
- [AI Voice Agents & Receptionists](https://jacobroutzong.dev/apps/leverline/use-cases/ai-voice-agents/): We set up AI voice agents that answer your phone 24/7, sound natural, answer common questions, qualify callers and book appointments straight into your calendar or field-service software.
- [Databricks & Snowflake Machine Learning](https://jacobroutzong.dev/apps/leverline/use-cases/databricks-snowflake-ml/): If your data lives in Databricks or Snowflake, the fastest path to AI usually runs through it. We build governed ML models, AI functions and agents directly on your platform, plus the MLOps to keep them healthy.
- [AI Demand Forecasting & Inventory Optimization](https://jacobroutzong.dev/apps/leverline/use-cases/ai-demand-forecasting/): We build machine-learning forecasts at the SKU and location level that account for seasonality, promotions and trends, then turn them into reorder recommendations your buyers can trust.
- [Churn Prediction & Customer Retention](https://jacobroutzong.dev/apps/leverline/use-cases/ai-churn-prediction/): We build churn and customer-health models from your usage, billing and support data, explain the reasons behind each risk score and connect them to the playbooks your team runs to save accounts.
- [Natural-Language Analytics](https://jacobroutzong.dev/apps/leverline/use-cases/ai-analytics/): We set up natural-language analytics so managers can ask "what drove the margin dip in the Southeast last quarter?" and get accurate, governed answers without waiting in the data team's queue.
- [AI App & Product Development](https://jacobroutzong.dev/apps/leverline/use-cases/ai-app-development/): We help companies design, prototype and ship AI features and standalone AI apps (copilots inside your software, customer-facing assistants and internal tools) with the evaluation and cost controls production needs.
- [AI Strategy, Readiness & Governance](https://jacobroutzong.dev/apps/leverline/use-cases/ai-strategy-governance/): We assess where AI fits your business, rank the opportunities by return and effort, and put the policies, training and governance in place so your team can adopt AI with confidence.

## Industries
- [Law Firms](https://jacobroutzong.dev/apps/leverline/industries/law-firms/): Law firms sell expertise by the hour or the matter, so time recovered from drafting, review and intake turns directly into capacity or margin. The catch is confidentiality: client data can't go into whatever tool an associate happens to like.
- [Accounting & Bookkeeping Firms](https://jacobroutzong.dev/apps/leverline/industries/accounting-firms/): Accounting firms face a talent shortage and a flood of documents. AI is best at exactly the work that eats staff time (collecting, reading and reconciling documents) while professionals stay focused on review and advice.
- [Healthcare Practices & Clinics](https://jacobroutzong.dev/apps/leverline/industries/healthcare-clinics/): Practices lose revenue to unanswered calls and lose clinician time to documentation and admin. AI can help with both, but only with vendors that sign business associate agreements and architectures that keep protected health information where it belongs.
- [Real Estate & Property Management](https://jacobroutzong.dev/apps/leverline/industries/real-estate/): In real estate the fastest credible response often wins the client. AI helps teams respond instantly, follow up consistently for months and handle the steady stream of tenant and owner requests without adding headcount.
- [Home Services & Contractors](https://jacobroutzong.dev/apps/leverline/industries/home-services/): For home service businesses, the phone is the cash register. Calls come in while techs are on jobs and the office is swamped, and a missed call is often a job that goes to the next company on the list.
- [E-commerce & Retail](https://jacobroutzong.dev/apps/leverline/industries/ecommerce-retail/): Online retailers have rich data and thin margins. AI turns order, browsing and inventory data into more relevant shopping experiences, leaner inventory and support that scales with peak season.
- [Manufacturing & Distribution](https://jacobroutzong.dev/apps/leverline/industries/manufacturing-distribution/): Manufacturers and distributors run on purchase orders, spec sheets and experienced people. AI can process the paperwork, forecast demand more accurately and capture expertise before it walks out the door.
- [SaaS & Technology Companies](https://jacobroutzong.dev/apps/leverline/industries/saas-technology/): For software companies, AI is both a product opportunity and an operating advantage. The winners ship reliable AI features quickly while using the same technology to retain customers and grow pipeline efficiently.
- [Marketing & Creative Agencies](https://jacobroutzong.dev/apps/leverline/industries/marketing-agencies/): Agencies are squeezed by clients who expect AI-level speed and pricing. The opportunity is to use AI to expand margins on existing services and add new AI offerings without hiring a team of engineers.
- [Defense & Government Contractors](https://jacobroutzong.dev/apps/leverline/industries/government-contractors/): Government contractors could save enormous time on proposals, compliance documentation and technical writing, but controlled unclassified information can't go to public AI services. Private models deployed inside the compliance boundary make AI usable.

## Insights
- [Private LLM vs. Cloud AI: A Decision Guide for Regulated Businesses](https://jacobroutzong.dev/apps/leverline/insights/private-llm-vs-cloud-ai/): When does it make sense to run your own language model instead of using a cloud AI service? Five questions, a cost formula and three architectures for firms that handle confidential or regulated data.
- [SMB AI Adoption in 2026 and Where Demand Goes Next](https://jacobroutzong.dev/apps/leverline/insights/smb-ai-adoption-outlook-2026/): What the latest Census, Federal Reserve, Gartner and industry surveys say about small-business AI adoption, and our outlook for which AI use cases businesses will fund through 2028.
